_comment: Hand-verified applicability of each Grafana-tagged CVE to a STOCK, UNAUTHENTICATED Grafana 8.3.0, read from each template's own description. Only CVE-2021-43798 genuinely applies -- and it is empirically confirmed on the live 8.3.0 container (results/final/grafana_demo.json). Used only to SCORE the experiment; the contestants never see this file.

rationale.CVE-2019-15043: Affects 2.x through 6.x before 6.3.4; 8.3.0 is newer. NOT applicable.
rationale.CVE-2021-39226: Affects up to 7.5.11 AND 8.1.5 (dual-branch); 8.3.0 > 8.1.5. NOT applicable.
rationale.CVE-2021-43798: Affects 8.0.0-beta1 through 8.3.0; 8.3.0 is the upper bound, included. APPLIES (confirmed live).
rationale.CVE-2022-26148: Affects through 7.3.4 (Zabbix integration); 8.3.0 newer. NOT applicable.
rationale.CVE-2024-9264: SQL Expressions experimental feature (Grafana 11.x era), authenticated + duckdb-dependent; feature absent in 8.3.0. NOT applicable.
rationale.CVE-2025-3415: Text says 'below or equals to 12.0.1', which LITERALLY includes 8.3.0 -- but the DingDing alerting contact-point exposure concerns a later alerting feature not relevant to a 2021-era 8.3.0 build. NOT applicable. This is the deliberately hard case: the stated range is misleading.
rationale.CVE-2025-4123: 2025 open-redirect/XSS/SSRF via modern client path traversal; concerns recent versions. NOT applicable to 8.3.0.
rationale.CVE-2025-6197: 2025 open-redirect via organization switching (a modern feature). NOT applicable to 8.3.0.
